features.name: Sales Validation Agent
features.description: A sample agent shipped out of the box that validates open sales orders and determines if they can be released for shipment. It checks orders against release criteria and provides a summary of actions taken.
caveats: User must prepare data before running agent
Only sample currently available in the wizard
Agent requires specific task formatting with shipment date

features.name: Agent Configuration Card
features.description: A configuration interface where users can review agent profile, permissions, instructions, and customize settings for the sales validation agent.

features.name: Agent Dedicated Profile
features.description: A limited UI profile assigned to the agent that restricts its interface to only the tasks it is supposed to perform.

features.name: Reduced Permission Sets
features.description: Agent access control that limits permissions to only the specific tasks the agent needs to perform, reducing security risk.

features.name: Agent Instructions
features.description: Customizable instructions that define how the agent behaves. Users can edit instructions to tweak agent behavior and assign specific tasks.
caveats: Instructions should follow specific formatting conventions as documented
Format for sales validation agent: run process and shipment date

features.name: Task Tracking UI
features.description: A user interface component that allows users to track the progress and steps of an agent task in real-time as it executes.

features.name: Outgoing Message Review
features.description: A feature that allows users to review and approve agent-generated messages summarizing completed actions, including which sales orders were released and which did not meet criteria.

features.name: Agent Credit Usage Tracking
features.description: A mechanism that displays how many API credits were consumed by an agent run, allowing users to monitor and manage the cost of agent operations.

features.name: More Sample Agents Coming
features.description: Microsoft has announced plans to build and release additional sample agents beyond the current sales validation agent.
